newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S.Korea's Pusan Leasing Co completes $40 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Pusan Leasing Co completes $40 mln FRN.

text.p: Pusan Leasing Co's US$40 million three-year floating rate notes issue has been completed, arranger KDB Asia said on Friday.
The notes, guaranteed by Pusan Bank, were priced at par to float at 45 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 55 basis points.
Arrangers are KDB Asia, LTCB Asia and Sumitomo Finance Asia.
Tokyo-Mitsubishi International (HK) is the co-lead manager.
DIE ERSTE osterreichische Spar-Casse-Bank Aktiengesellschaft is the manager.
Signing is set for December 30. The payment date is January 30, 1997.
